source_name: PrivatBank supplier-facing tender rules page (Проведення тендерів в ПриватБанку)
why_relevant: Buyer-side terms: how to register as supplier, participation rules, and the complaints channel (complaint.tender@privatbank.ua). Gives the supplier-qualification bar a vendor like Printec would have to clear.

source_name: Ukreximbank official procurement section (Закупівлі)
source_subtype: buyer-owned procurement page + annual plan PDFs
why_relevant: Ukreximbank's own buyer page: general procurement conditions, annual procurement plans as PDFs, and announcements of two-stage procedures and commercial-proposal selections that sit outside standard Prozorro open bidding.

source_name: Ukrgasbank official procurement page (Закупівлі / тендерний комітет)
why_relevant: Ukrgasbank's own tender-committee page carrying annual procurement plans (rp_*.pdf) and draft procurement contracts (DKT_*.doc) — draft contracts are unusually valuable, they expose payment terms, SLA and warranty clauses a supplier must accept.

source_name: Ukrposhta newsroom — procurement announcements
why_relevant: Ukrposhta announces large tenders (ERP ~UAH 197m; bank terminals) through press releases before/alongside Prozorro, often with volume and value context the tender notice omits. Early-warning channel for the Ukrposhta Bank hardware build-out.

source_name: Sense Bank Prozorro buyer feed (АТ «СЕНС БАНК», EDRPOU 23494714)
why_relevant: Sense Bank was nationalised in 2023 and now publishes procurement on Prozorro (IT support, Cisco/Hitachi renewals, custom software, facilities). Note the bank has in places stated it is not a 'Замовник' under the public procurement law — so its Prozorro presence may be voluntary/partial, which itself is intelligence about coverage limits.

source_name: Oschadbank branch-level buyer profiles (regional управління, separate EDRPOUs)
source_subtype: aggregator buyer directory (pointer to branch EDRPOU list)
why_relevant: Critically, Oschadbank procures not only under head-office EDRPOU 00032129 but under ~20 separate regional branch EDRPOUs (e.g. Dnipropetrovsk 09305480, Lviv 09325703, Poltava 09331508, Ternopil 09338500, Kyiv HQ region 09322277). Anyone filtering on the head-office code alone will miss a large slice of ATM/terminal consumables and branch equipment demand.

source_name: Clarity Project — buyer/entity dossiers by EDRPOU
why_relevant: Aggregates a state bank's tender history, counterparties, contracts and registry data into one buyer dossier — the fastest way to see which suppliers repeatedly win a given bank's equipment and IT lots.

source_name: DOZORRO — procurement monitoring profiles and complaint/risk feed
why_relevant: Civil-society monitoring layer over Prozorro: per-buyer profiles, risk indicators, complaints and monitoring reports. Reveals contested awards and disqualifications at state banks and Diia-adjacent operators — i.e. where a supplier lost and why.

source_name: Zakupki.prom.ua — buyer pages for state banks and state operators
why_relevant: One of the largest accredited Prozorro marketplaces; its buyer pages present the same tenders with marketplace-side supplier context and are often better indexed by search engines than prozorro.gov.ua itself, making them a practical discovery route.

source_name: Opendatabot — tenders by company (АТ «УКРЕКСІМБАНК» and peers)
why_relevant: Registry-and-tender mashup with alerting; useful as a change-notification layer on a specific buyer EDRPOU without building polling infrastructure, and links tenders to corporate/registry events at the bank.

source_name: gov.e-tender.ua — EDRPOU buyer search
why_relevant: Another accredited marketplace exposing a clean per-EDRPOU buyer view for Oschadbank and NBU; a cheap redundancy source when prozorro.gov.ua or a bank's own site is unreachable.

source_name: ДП «ДІЯ» (State Enterprise Diia) procurement page
why_relevant: The Diia-adjacent state operator (EDRPOU 43395033) running the Diia portal/app infrastructure. Its procurement covers identity, e-services and IT infrastructure that intersects with digital-onboarding and payment-adjacent rails; ~75 contracts recorded. Buyer-side terms visible on its own site plus the Prozorro/DOZORRO profiles.

source_name: National Bank of Ukraine as Prozorro buyer (EDRPOU 00032106)
why_relevant: The NBU is itself a buyer and the operator of the national card scheme ПРОСТІР; its procurement covers payment-system infrastructure, cash-handling and security tech. Adjacent to but distinct from the state commercial banks, and a demand signal for the whole national payment rail.

source_name: Банкнотно-монетний двір НБУ (Banknote Printing and Minting Works, EDRPOU 21575489) buyer profile
why_relevant: Separate NBU-owned buyer covering banknote/coin production, secure printing and — relevantly — card production and personalisation capability in Ukraine. A distinct EDRPOU that a bank-name-only filter would miss entirely.

source_name: tender.uub.com.ua — Ukrainian Universal Exchange Prozorro marketplace (buyer directory)
why_relevant: The single most productive pointer found in this cell: it exposes stable /company-<EDRPOU>/ buyer directory URLs, which is how the Oschadbank branch network, Sense Bank, Ukrgasbank, Ukrposhta, NBU and the Banknote Mint were all enumerated. Good for actor discovery, not for bulk collection.

source_name: Ukreximbank news/announcements feed (Оголошення про проведення конкурсу / відбір комерційних пропозицій)
source_subtype: corporate newsroom used as procurement channel
why_relevant: Ukreximbank publishes competitive selections as news items, not only in the procurement section — a parallel channel for non-Prozorro competitive procedures (consultancy, leasing, banking services). Missing it leaves a hole in the buyer's real demand picture.

source_name: Ukreximbank collateral / own-property auctions (Поточні торги)
why_relevant: Sell-side rather than buy-side, but it reveals what banking/IT hardware a state bank is disposing of — an early indicator of fleet refresh cycles (e.g. ATM or branch-equipment write-offs preceding a replacement tender).

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — supplier participation guidance (infobox.prozorro.org)
why_relevant: Official knowledge base explaining buyer/supplier roles, procedure types and the wartime 'відкриті торги з особливостями' regime — needed to interpret state-bank buyer records correctly (e.g. why auctions are currently absent).

source_name: Law of Ukraine 'Про публічні закупівлі' on zakon.rada.gov.ua
why_relevant: Defines who counts as a 'Замовник' — decisive for this cell, because Sense Bank and PrivatBank have argued differing scopes of obligation. Determines how much of each state bank's spend is legally forced into the public record versus handled on its own portal.

source_name: Prozorro — public procurement portal, buyer profile: National Bank of Ukraine (EDRPOU 00032106)
why_relevant: NBU is statutorily obliged to publish its tenders in Prozorro. This buyer-scoped view is the single highest-value stream for rail-level technology procurement (SEP/ISO 20022 systems, HSMs, cash-processing, certification, IT services) by the central bank itself.

source_name: Prozorro — buyer profile: Banknote Printing and Minting Works of the NBU (Банкнотно-монетний двір, EDRPOU 21575489)
why_relevant: The BMD is the state's banknote/coin producer and a heavy buyer of printing, security-substrate, cash-handling and inspection equipment. Its tender flow is the clearest signal of cash-cycle and minting technology renewal in UA.

source_name: National Bank of Ukraine — official Procurements page (bank.gov.ua/ua/about/procurements)
why_relevant: NBU's own procurement disclosure hub: annual procurement plans, rules, non-Prozorro (exempt) purchases and contact points. Captures purchases that never appear in Prozorro because of central-bank exemptions.

source_name: Transparency International Ukraine — procurement analysis and news (ti-ukraine.org)
why_relevant: Publishes analysis of procurement policy changes, including cases where NBU purchases were proposed to bypass Prozorro — exactly the kind of visibility risk that would blind this collection cell.

source_name: Spending / Є-data — Unified web portal on the use of public funds (Treasury transactions)
why_relevant: Actual payment transactions and concluded contracts, not just announcements. Reveals who really got paid by state-sector payment-infrastructure buyers and in what amounts, closing the gap between award notice and delivery.
